query:
SELECT p.id, p.totalHours, p.usedHours, p.startDate, p.endDate, p.isActive, r.firstName, r.lastName 
FROM packages p 
JOIN residents r ON p.residentId = r.id 
WHERE r.firstName = 'Nicolas' AND r.lastName = 'Klein' AND p.isActive = 1;
